body:
**MMR-33 note: open question on loading**

Town villages' trade bounds after a load are still open. In run 2244 (MMR-30), the towns did not list their villages after the load.

MMR-33 established only the castle-village mechanism. `VillageTradeBoundCampaignBehavior.UpdateTradeBounds` iterates `Campaign.AllCastles` and assigns their villages a trade town on new game, load, war, peace and owner change (installed IL). That does not explain the town case. See docs/campaign-registry.md.
